located_point.method: Centre of the bare, bright mound area (about 630 m across, surrounded by canal-colony fields aligned to the cadastral grid) in the Sentinel-2 median composite, UTM 43N E 415600 N 3260750; the Wikidata starting point (29.47389, 74.12972) falls inside the same area. The layout of KLB-1, KLB-2 and KLB-3 on Fig. 22.2 fits inside this area, but no plan feature could be tied to a particular image feature.

sources.result: No line measured. The mound surface is mottled at 10 m in every layer and stretch, with no straight feature that matches a wall, street or platform edge of the plans. The straight north and east edges of the bare area follow the surrounding field grid and are field boundaries, not architecture.

notes: Imagery: not measurable at 10 m (see the imagery source entry). Plans: two drawings of the 1960-69 ASI survey were measured as separate sources. On Fig. 22.2 the walls running across the mounds (all four KLB-1 walls and the KLB-2 north and south walls) lie at theta -6.7 to -11.1 degrees from the plan arrow, while the long east and west walls of KLB-2 lie at -2.8 and -0.9 degrees, so the lower-city enclosure is drawn as a parallelogram skewed by about 8 degrees. The rule selects klb1-walls (427 m) as the main system of this source; the KLB-2 cross walls (-9.8 degrees) agree with it, and we regard the cross-wall direction shared by both mounds as the better summary of the town's layout on this plan. All Fig. 22.2 lines share one arrow error of 2.5 degrees, so their system standard errors are dominated by that common term. On Fig. 3.7 the KLB-2 northern and southern walls and four streets form the main system (klb2-grid, about -12.6 degrees from that plan's arrow); the KLB-2 east and west walls are skewed by 12-15 degrees from the street grid, and the KLB-1 cross and south walls (-13.1 and -13.8) follow the KLB-2 grid direction. The two plans' arrows are not of known reference and differ in drawing: relative to the cross walls, the Fig. 3.7 arrow sits about 3 degrees further clockwise than the Fig. 22.2 arrow, which is within the Fig. 22.2 arrow error. Systems were grouped by mound and by direction; the picks carried provisional labels, recorded as system_in_picks where changed. No registration was possible because no plan feature could be identified in the imagery.
plan_search: Held: ASI Memoir 110 Part II (2020) with the cemetery location plan; University of Lucknow chapter Fig. 3.7; a Cambridge PhD thesis (Suryanarayan 2019, file kalibangan2020.pdf) without architectural plans. Part I (2015) with the detailed architectural plans is not openly available (web search 21 October 2026). A University of Lucknow note on Kalibangan was downloaded (downloads-H/lko-durgesh-kalibangan) and contains text only.
